name: paga-justo
description: PagaJusto - AI Escrow for Freelancers on Stellar

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
